hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting tailored to your home. Free estimates, no pressure, and work you can trust.
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to exterior weatherproofing, we handle every aspect of painting and property finishing work.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Full interior repaints, wallpapering, and colour consultation. We protect your furniture and floors, and leave your rooms spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior finishes for render, woodwork, and masonry. Includes surface preparation and sealant work to protect against Leeds' climate.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery
services.desc: Sanding, priming, and finishing doors, skirting, and window frames. We use premium paints for durability and a professional look.

services.title: Fence & Gate Painting
services.desc: Restore weathered garden fences and gates with durable exterior stain and paint. Protection against rot and year-round wear.

services.title: Property Maintenance
services.desc: Caulking, sealant repairs, and touch-ups to keep your home in top condition. Small jobs welcome alongside larger projects.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office, retail, and industrial painting with minimal disruption to your business. Flexible scheduling and professional-grade finishes.

about_pullquote: I do the work I'd be happy to see in my own home.
about_para_1: AJQ Decorating started over a decade ago with a simple idea: offer honest, skilled painting and decorating without the inflated quotes and unnecessary pressure. We've built our reputation on reliability and attention to detail, completing hundreds of projects across Leeds and the surrounding areas. Every job—whether a small interior touch-up or a full exterior repaint—receives the same level of care and professionalism.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're fair. Our customers come back because we prep properly, use quality materials, and finish on time. We take pride in leaving your home looking better than it did, with no hidden charges or rushed work. When you call AJQ, you're speaking to someone who genuinely cares about the result.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About AJQ

reviews.text: Needed the hallway and landing done before Christmas. Got a quote within two days, and the work was spot on. Moved all the furniture, protected everything, and left no mess. Fair price too. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Exterior woodwork on our bungalow was looking shabby. AJQ came out, gave us honest advice on what needed doing, and the finished job looks brilliant. Not the quickest job, but the quality is there and they were professional throughout.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had a small damp patch that needed covering up and redecorating. Rang on a Thursday, and they were round the following Monday. Fixed the underlying issue properly and the paint finish is perfect. Will use them again.
reviews.author: James H.
